historical_references.reference: Ibn Al-Athir, Al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh, Volume 11, Page 358, mentions a poet named Ulfaat ibn Al-Harith Al-Khawlan, who lived during the early Abbasid period (750-827 AD) and was known for his panegyric poetry in praise of the Abbasid caliphs.

Ibn Abi Al-Dunya, Al-Aghani, Volume 1, Page 119, mentions a singer named Ulfaat ibn Al-Sharik Al-Asadi, who lived during the Abbasid period (750-1258 AD) and was one of the most famous singers of the earliest Abbasid court. He is known for his famous song 'Ulfaat's song (Aasihah Ulfaatiyah).'
